page.layout: One printed page, cut at the right: a decorative rule and head at top, then a two-column errata table (Pag. | Lin. | Lege, and at right a second Pag. column). Running title and heading are centred across the top. Left column of the table is the main block; the right column of page numbers continues to the right of the scan.; One printed page, cut at the left; a running head with a fleuron band at top, then a table of errata in two columns (line numbers, Lin., and Lege corrections), a signature at the foot left and a page reference at the foot right.
